build_dataset_train: build a torchvision ImageFolder dataset for training with data_path and transform arguments
build_dataset_eval: build a torchvision ImageFolder dataset for validation with data_path and transform arguments
build_transform_train: build a training transform with color jitter, auto augment, and random erasing via timm
build_transform_eval: build an evaluation transform with resize, center crop, and ImageNet normalization
review_build_dataset: review the build_dataset function that creates an ImageFolder from args.data_path
